, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COURSE_SURVEY_ANSWER A INNER JOIN COURSE_STUDENT S ON S.ID = A.COURSE_STUDENT_ID WHERE A.COURSE_SURVEY_ID = CS.ID AND S.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} AND S.USER_ID = #{userId}) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ANSWERED_YN FROM COURSE_SURVEY CS INNER JOIN (SELECT COUNT(ID) AS STUDENT_COUNT FROM COURSE_STUDENT WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}) STU ON 1 = 1 LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT COURSE_SURVEY_ID , COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_STUDENT_ID) AS ANSWER_COUNT FROM COURSE_SURVEY_ANSWER WHERE COURSE_SURVEY_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM COURSE_SURVEY WHERE COURSE_ID = #{courseId}) GROUP BY COURSE_SURVEY_ID) ANS ON ANS.COURSE_SURVEY_ID = CS.ID WHERE CS.COURSE_ID = #{courseId} ORDER BY CS.ID
